source_build: Clean git archive of the source commit; unchanged repository test fixtures; release-fast profile.
pass_rate_definition: passed / (passed + failed); skipped cases excluded, never counted as passes.

errors.command: cargo run --profile release-fast -p tsc_rs_harness --bin baseline-report -- --suite compiler --baseline errors --no-cache --save-manifest /tmp/compiler-errors.json

js.command: cargo run --profile release-fast -p tsc_rs_harness --bin baseline-report -- --suite compiler --baseline js --no-cache --save-manifest /tmp/compiler-js.json

js-expanded.command: cargo run --profile release-fast -p tsc_rs_harness --bin baseline-report -- --suite compiler --baseline js --no-cache --save-manifest /tmp/compiler-js-expanded.json --expand-variants --manifest-schema 2

declarations-expanded.command: cargo run --profile release-fast -p tsc_rs_harness --bin baseline-report -- --suite compiler --baseline declarations --no-cache --save-manifest /tmp/compiler-declarations-expanded.json --expand-variants --manifest-schema 2

symbols.command: cargo run --profile release-fast -p tsc_rs_harness --bin baseline-report -- --suite compiler --baseline symbols --no-cache --save-manifest /tmp/compiler-symbols.json

errors.command: cargo run --profile release-fast -p tsc_rs_harness --bin baseline-report -- --suite conformance --baseline errors --no-cache --save-manifest /tmp/conformance-errors.json

js.command: cargo run --profile release-fast -p tsc_rs_harness --bin baseline-report -- --suite conformance --baseline js --no-cache --save-manifest /tmp/conformance-js.json

js-expanded.command: cargo run --profile release-fast -p tsc_rs_harness --bin baseline-report -- --suite conformance --baseline js --no-cache --save-manifest /tmp/conformance-js-expanded.json --expand-variants --manifest-schema 2

declarations-expanded.command: cargo run --profile release-fast -p tsc_rs_harness --bin baseline-report -- --suite conformance --baseline declarations --no-cache --save-manifest /tmp/conformance-declarations-expanded.json --expand-variants --manifest-schema 2

symbols.command: cargo run --profile release-fast -p tsc_rs_harness --bin baseline-report -- --suite conformance --baseline symbols --no-cache --save-manifest /tmp/conformance-symbols.json

compiler.command: cargo run --profile release-fast -p tsc_rs_harness --bin typecheck-report -- --suite compiler --json

conformance.command: cargo run --profile release-fast -p tsc_rs_harness --bin typecheck-report -- --suite conformance --json

quickinfo.command: cargo run --profile release-fast -p tsc_rs_harness --bin lsp-report -- --op quickinfo --json

completions.command: cargo run --profile release-fast -p tsc_rs_harness --bin lsp-report -- --op completions --json

gotodefinition.command: cargo run --profile release-fast -p tsc_rs_harness --bin lsp-report -- --op gotodefinition --json

findallrefs.command: cargo run --profile release-fast -p tsc_rs_harness --bin lsp-report -- --op findallrefs --json

signaturehelp.command: cargo run --profile release-fast -p tsc_rs_harness --bin lsp-report -- --op signaturehelp --json

diagnostic_accuracy_definition: Full expanded errors inventory; matches file basename, line and TS code with multiplicity, excluding configuration codes TS5101, TS5102, TS5107 and TS5108. Does not require exact diagnostic message or column.
lsp_total_definition: Sum of the five listed operation suites; excludes rename and is not a count of unique source files.
